cohort: 84,924 women who delivered in one of 46 referral hospitals in Mali and Senegal
finding: Grand multiparity, prior cesarean, residence outside the hospital region, no prenatal care visits, birth weight > 3600 g, referral status, and obstructed labor were significant predictors of uterine rupture.
birth_weight: Birth weight > 3600 g was a significant predictor of uterine rupture.
